parsed.summary: The patch introduces a non-minimal change and may have unintended side effects.

issues.description: The change modifies the behavior of the `save` method for all models, not just the child models. This could have unintended side effects on other parts of the codebase.
The approach of setting `force_insert` to `True` when `self.pk is None` may not be the correct or intended behavior for all cases. It could lead to incorrect data insertion or updates.
